description: This file defines a singleton pattern implementation in Python using a mixin class, a metaclass, and associated exception handling. It includes classes for managing singleton instances, preventing subclass __new__ overrides, and testing the singleton behavior.

classes.name: SingletonException
classes.description: Custom exception class for singleton-related errors.

classes.name: MetaSingleton
classes.description: Metaclass that enforces singleton constraints, such as disallowing __new__ overrides and controlling instantiation.

classes.name: Singleton
classes.description: Base class implementing singleton behavior with controlled instantiation via getInstance, including handling of constructor arguments and testing utilities.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Class method to instantiate or retrieve the singleton instance, with argument handling.

methods.name: _isInstantiated
methods.description: Class method to check if the singleton instance has been created.

methods.name: _getConstructionArgCountNotCountingSelf
methods.description: Class method to determine the number of __init__ arguments excluding 'self'.

methods.name: _forgetClassInstanceReferenceForTesting
methods.description: Class method to delete the singleton instance reference for testing purposes.
